headline: Israel's Bank Leumi Delivers NIS 3 Billion Q3 Profit, Sets Large Dividend
summary: Bank Leumi posted a third-quarter net profit of NIS 3 billion and declared a cash dividend of NIS 1.5 billion, underscoring resilient earnings growth in Israel's banking sector.
why: Bank Leumi is one of Israel's two dominant retail and commercial lenders; its earnings reflect broader domestic economic resilience and interest rate margin trends.

impacts.name: Bank Leumi
impacts.why: A strong NIS 3 billion quarterly profit accompanied by a NIS 1.5 billion dividend supports shareholder returns.
